title: Telomere Evolution Lab
description: Telomere Evolution Lab is a stochastic, population-level simulator of telomere attrition, maintenance and replicative senescence, coupled to an evolutionary search over virtual experimental conditions. It is a hypothesis-generation and teaching tool, not a predictor: it is not fitted to patient data and is not intended for diagnosis or clinical use. Runs are reproducible from a seed and configuration through a run ledger.
